reason: Case-control study measuring global DNA methylation by luminometric assay in peripheral blood of Alzheimer's cases versus controls, proposed as a risk-screening marker.
A rank-based DNA methylation classifier is developed and evaluated across disease-versus-normal-control cohorts for five cancer types, a diagnostic-accuracy use of an eligible marker.
This is a GWAS pathway analysis of SNPs (including one near HIST3H3) with no DNA methylation, histone modification, or chromatin state directly measured.
Retrospective propensity-matched cohort of elderly glioblastoma patients in which MGMT promoter methylation was assessed and identified as the strongest prognostic factor.
Case-control methylation microarray study identifying CpG sites in PM20D1, CALD1, WT1 and KCNQ1 linked to stroke and obesity in white blood cells.
Micronucleus assay scoring apoptosis and necrosis in oral mucosa of steroid users does not measure any DNA methylation, histone, or chromatin marker.
Genome-wide methylation array identified PCDH gene methylation in cervical scrapings, validated across CIN/cancer cohorts as an early-detection diagnostic marker.
Study measures serum wnt5a gene expression as a prognostic biomarker for liver failure, with no epigenetic marker assessed.
Phase III randomized trial in newly diagnosed glioblastoma/gliosarcoma that performed MGMT promoter methylation analysis on tumor tissue to examine its prognostic impact.
Association of CHD4 missense SNP variants with cancer risk is a genetic-variant study, not a measurement of chromatin state or any epigenetic mark.
DNA methylation of MUC2 and MUC5AC was quantified in colorectal cancer versus control tissue and linked to MSI status, a diagnostic association.
MGMT promoter methylation was assessed in melanoma patient tumor biopsies and associated with chemotherapy response and progression-free survival.
DNA methylation at the miR-34b promoter was measured in blood of shiftworkers versus dayworkers, a case-control design linking methylation to an occupational exposure.
Study measures human antibody cross-reactivity against parasitic Leishmania histone antigens by ELISA, not a human chromatin or histone modification.
Describes an undergraduate teaching lab exercise simulating methylation-specific PCR on tissue slides, not a primary research study.
Case-control genetic association study genotyping H2AFZ tag SNPs in schizophrenia, without measuring histone modification levels.

The study is primarily a mouse BPA-exposure model and the abstract does not clearly state whether BDNF methylation in human cord blood was newly measured under a defined comparative design or only cited as consistent with prior findings.
Multicentre prospective cohort measuring methylation of miR-124a-3, EMX1 and NKX6-1 by quantitative methylation-specific PCR to predict metachronous gastric cancer risk.
Longitudinal study of cord-blood vitamin D and cytokine responses to allergens/TLR ligands, with no epigenetic marker measured.
Flow cytometry assessment of minimal residual disease in AML as a dosing biomarker does not involve any epigenetic measurement.

gammaH2AX, a histone mark, was measured in CLL patient samples across SF3B1/ATM/TP53 subgroups, but the abstract does not clearly tie the marker itself to a stated clinical decision rather than to the genetic mutation subtype.
Although PLZF promoter methylation was tested in 5 paired HCC samples, the diagnostic ROC analysis reported is based on PLZF protein expression, not on the methylation measurement itself.
Community-based autopsy cohort measuring brain DNA methylation at 28 Alzheimer's loci (SORL1, ABCA7, HLA-DRB5, SLC24A4, BIN1) associated with pathological AD diagnosis.
Case-control study measuring p16 promoter methylation by MSP in esophageal cancer, linked to betel/tobacco chewing exposure as a susceptibility biomarker.
CMA3 staining assesses sperm chromatin packaging quality in hyperinsulinaemic men treated with metformin, a chromatin-packaging integrity measure rather than a regulatory epigenetic mark.
gamma-H2AX foci were scored in peripheral blood lymphocytes of paediatric patients before and after CT scans, linking a histone modification to radiation dose from a medical imaging exposure.
Cross-sectional study of 138 women measuring p16INK4a promoter methylation in healthy breast tissue in relation to alcohol consumption and folate status.
Cohort of 193 resected colorectal cancer patients with TFAP2E methylation status determined and correlated with relapse-free and overall survival.
Retrospective cohort of high-grade glioma patients classified by MGMT promoter methylation status and correlated with PET metabolic uptake, a prognostic imaging correlate.
Retrospective comparison of systemic therapies including HDAC inhibitors for mycosis fungoides reports treatment time-to-next-treatment outcomes without measuring any histone modification.
LINE-1 methylation was quantified by pyrosequencing in human placenta samples from an FGR case-control study linked to prenatal phthalate exposure.

CIMP and LINE-1 methylation are only adjustment covariates in a study relating signet-ring/mucinous histology to CRC mortality; the epigenetic markers themselves are not the exposure-outcome relationship examined.
Epigenome-wide 450K array study in discovery and replication cohorts identifying MYO1G and CNTNAP2 CpGs differentially methylated with prenatal maternal smoke exposure.
Cross-sectional EWAS of 400 adults linking blood and urinary arsenic concentrations to white blood cell DNA methylation at PLA2G2C and other loci.
Reports somatic loss-of-function mutations in the H3K27me3 demethylase UTX in T-ALL patients; H3K27me3 levels themselves were not directly measured in patient samples.
LINE-1 methylation was measured by pyrosequencing in 208 resected hepatocellular carcinomas and correlated with disease-free survival.
Pyrosequencing-based DNA methylation assay of RARbeta2 promoter in ejaculate and tissue samples evaluated as a noninvasive prostate cancer diagnostic test.
Within a stage III colon cancer trial cohort, MLH1 promoter methylation was measured to define MMR-deficient sporadic tumors, associated with disease-free survival.
Epigenome-wide DNA methylation profiling of newborn cord blood leukocytes in a prenatal arsenic exposure cohort (BEAR study), linked to birth outcomes.
Measures serum anti-citrullinated protein antibodies targeting histone, an autoantibody assay rather than a direct chromatin or histone-modification measurement.
Next-generation sequencing identified mutations in chromatin-remodeling genes (KDM6A, SETD2, MLL2/3) in thymic tumors, without measuring chromatin state itself.
ChIP experiments characterizing p300/CBP recruitment to the Gankyrin promoter were performed in cell lines/reporter constructs, not directly on human patient chromatin.
Case-control study measuring PPARGC1A DNA methylation in muscle biopsies of adults born small versus appropriate for gestational age, linked to fasting metabolic response.
HDAC2 protein expression was measured by western blot in an AECOPD corticosteroid trial, which is enzyme protein level rather than a histone modification measurement.
Genome-wide 450K methylation analysis in screening and validation sets identified ZNF695 promoter methylation predicting response to definitive chemoradiotherapy in esophageal cancer.
Blood DNA methylation at 21 OPRM1 CpGs was measured in adolescents and linked to prenatal cigarette smoke exposure interacting with fat intake.
Global, LINE-1, and satellite-2 DNA methylation were measured in blood leukocytes of nuclear power plant workers, linked to occupational radiation dose.
DNA methylation at ORMDL3/GSDMB CpG sites was measured and compared between asthmatic and control children, correlating with genotype and mRNA levels.
Immunohistochemical analysis of GASC1 (a histone demethylase) and target proteins builds a three-gene prognostic signature from protein expression, not direct histone-mark measurement.
A propidium-iodide sperm nuclear vacuole assay classifies nuclear morphology in fertile versus varicocele men, not a regulatory epigenetic mark.
Genome-wide methylation screening identified a HYAL2 CpG site in peripheral blood, validated in two independent case-control rounds as a breast cancer detection marker.
Cross-sectional multipollutant analysis of contaminant exposure and reproductive biomarkers including sperm chromatin integrity, with no DNA methylation or histone marker measured.
Methylation-sensitive high-resolution melting assessed RASSF1A, WIF1, DAPK1 and RARbeta2 methylation in biopsies and plasma for early detection of nasopharyngeal carcinoma.
TCGA-derived DNA methylation and mutation data for FABP7 were analyzed in ccRCC versus matched normal kidney and correlated with patient survival, a secondary analysis of individual-level human data.
Glucocorticoid gene sets were defined using cell-line ChIP-seq and murine fetal lung expression data, with no direct chromatin or methylation measurement in the human asthma cohort itself.
Phase I/II trial of azacitidine plus docetaxel in mCRPC measured GADD45A promoter methylation before and after treatment to assess demethylation and reversal of resistance.
Cohort study using a five-marker CIMP panel (CACNA1G, IGF2, NEUROG1, RUNX3, SOCS1) classified colon cancer patients and correlated CIMP-high status with mortality.
Case-control genotyping of MBD4 tag SNPs and esophageal cancer risk does not measure DNA methylation or any epigenetic mark.
Methylation-specific PCR quantified TCF21 promoter methylation in gastric cancer versus adjacent normal tissue, correlating with cancer-specific survival.
Multicenter phase I dose-escalation trial of intra-arterial temozolomide in melanoma evaluated MGMT promoter methylation status as a biomarker correlate of treatment response.
NGS-based germline mutation screening across 18 CRC-associated genes is a genetic testing study without any epigenetic marker measured.
Real-time PCR measured EZH2 mRNA expression levels in CLL patients, not the H3K27 methylation mark EZH2 catalyzes.
Study measures phosphorylated SIRT1 (Ser47) protein activation status in HCC tumors, not histone acetylation, the mark SIRT1 catalytically removes.
Longitudinal military cohort with Illumina 450K-derived DNAm age (epigenetic clock) measured before and after deployment, related to trauma exposure and PTSD symptoms.

This is an inter-laboratory proficiency/telescoring intercomparison exercise of the gamma-H2AX biodosimetry assay across 8 labs, a technical validation exercise rather than a comparative patient-group study.
Mutational analysis of the CREBBP gene (a histone acetyltransferase) in Rubinstein-Taybi syndrome patients does not directly measure histone acetylation.
Neuropathological study of abusive head trauma using APP immunohistochemistry for axonal injury, with no epigenetic marker assessed.
Next-generation bisulfite sequencing and pyrosequencing quantified HPV16 methylation in cervical DNA to distinguish precancer (CIN2-3) from transient infection.
Cross-sectional genome-wide methylation profiling of blood in 69 Greek preadolescents correlated with dietary fat intake ratios.
Case-control study measuring 5-methylcytosine content by HPLC in leukocytes of type 2 diabetics, predicting diabetic retinopathy risk.
ELISA and quantitative methylation-specific PCR measured global and gene-specific (SSBP2, ESR1) DNA methylation to distinguish gallbladder cancer from cholecystitis.
Prospective case-control study measuring DNA methylation of CYP27B1, VDR and RXR in placental tissue, comparing women with and without preeclampsia.
Pyrosequencing measured FOXP3 locus methylation in children from Fresno, CA, linked to ambient polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbon exposure and Treg dysfunction.
Targeted DNA methylation profiling of 1,505 CpG loci in 76-141 GIST tumors identified SPP1 promoter hypomethylation as an independent prognostic factor.
LSD1 (a histone demethylase) expression was assessed by RT-PCR, western blot and immunohistochemistry in tongue cancer, not the H3K4/H3K9 methylation mark it removes.
Quantitative methylation-specific PCR tested EDNRB, CDKN2A and DCC hypermethylation in serum of HNSCC patients versus healthy controls as a detection biomarker.
TLR7/TLR9 protein expression was assessed by tissue microarray in HCC/cirrhosis samples with no DNA methylation or histone marker measured.
Prospective study comparing CDH4/GATA5 methylated alleles in pre- versus post-operative stool DNA of CRC patients, evaluating a screening test's origin from the tumor.
Cross-sectional cohort measuring GATA-4 promoter methylation in induced sputum DNA of COPD smokers, associated with respiratory health status scores.

Predictive models for burn-patient infection are built from blood transcriptome gene-expression profiles; epigenetic modulation is only mentioned as a pathway-enrichment interpretation, not measured directly.
Quantitative methylation-specific PCR measured CDO1, ZSCAN18 and ZNF331 methylation across colorectal, gastric, pancreatic and cell-line samples as biomarkers.
Bisulfite sequencing measured DNA methylation at 43 MAO-A CpG sites in 94 depression patients treated with escitalopram, relating methylation to antidepressant treatment response.
Nested methylation-specific PCR assessed methylation of five DNA-damage-repair genes (CHFR, FANCF, MGMT, MLH1, RASSF1A) in gastric cancer, linked to chemo-sensitivity.
The marker examined across 232 ESCC patients is expression of the long non-coding RNA 91H; H19 ICR methylation is referenced mechanistically but not measured as a patient-level marker.
Promoter methylation of DENND2D was evaluated in 112 paired gastric cancer/noncancerous tissue specimens and linked to prognosis and early recurrence.
Chromatin immunoprecipitation for TBL1XR1 binding to the VEGF-C promoter was performed as an in vitro mechanistic assay, not measured directly in patient tumor chromatin.
Two-stage case-control genotyping of SWI/SNF complex gene variants (SMARCA4, BRD7, etc.) and pancreatic cancer risk does not measure chromatin state directly.
Study characterizes ectopic prolactin transcript truncation in lung tumors and notes HDAC inhibitors as a possible therapeutic strategy, without measuring any epigenetic mark in patients.
Blood DNA methylation was measured pre/post an 18-month diet/exercise weight-loss randomized trial (CENTRAL) and correlated with dementia progression risk in the ADNI cohort.
Cross-sectional analysis of 928 Airwave cohort participants measuring eleven DNA methylation-based epigenetic clocks in relation to smoking status and Mediterranean diet adherence.
Genome-wide blood DNA methylation was profiled in 639 ADNI participants across CN/MCI/AD groups and analyzed with Cox models for clinical conversion to Alzheimer's disease.
Cluster-randomized INCAP nutrition supplementation trial measured DNA methylation-based epigenetic age (DunedinPACE, PhenoAge, GrimAge) in adults exposed to early-life protein-energy supplementation.
Leukocyte DNA methylation-based risk scores were developed in the Million Veteran Program EWAS cohort and evaluated for incremental prediction of incident atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease.
Large multi-ancestry epigenome-wide association study in the Million Veteran Program measured DNA methylation associated with PTSD diagnosis and symptom severity.
In 45,091 Veterans, DNA methylation-based epigenetic age (Horvath, Hannum, PhenoAge, GrimAge, DunedinPACE) was measured and related to PTSD diagnosis, severity, and duration.
Cross-sectional CLSA analysis of 8,516 adults measured six DNA methylation age models alongside metabolomic age and inflammatory biomarkers, linked to socioeconomic disadvantage.
Cross-sectional NHANES analysis of 4,702 adults used DNA methylation-based PhenoAge acceleration in relation to a behavioral rhythm score encompassing sleep, diet and activity.
Pilot case-control EWAS profiled genome-wide DNA methylation (EPIC v2.0) in pooled blood DNA from 10 peripheral artery disease patients versus 22 controls, identifying differentially methylated loci.
Randomized placebo-controlled metformin trial in 145 older adults measured DNA methylation-based epigenetic clocks (PC-Horvath2, PC-Hannum) as outcomes of the intervention.
Longitudinal PPMI cohort measured seven DNA methylation-based epigenetic aging clocks and related their acceleration to progression of tremor and other motor impairment in Parkinson's disease.
